🍴 Struggling with distracted dinners? You're not alone. The average American checks their phone 52 times per day - and that includes meals!

Lines:
💡 Set clear boundaries. Announce "no phones at the table" before every meal, modeling respectful conversation
👨‍👩‍👧 Make it fun! Create phone "pocket stations" away from the dining area, or use decorative bowls as collecting points
⏰ Extend the pause. Start with smaller goals (like just dessert) and gradually work toward entire meal breaks

Try these tips tonight! Let us know how it goes—we'd love to hear your family's progress. #DigitalGuardian #DigitalParenting
